notes.title: Notification of distribution guidelines for "In His Time".*Updated 10/12
notes.content:
*Updated 10/12 (The restriction on scenes that can be delivered has been removed.)

We hope you will spread the world of In His Time to many people.
Best regards!

Guidelines for distribution and video contribution of "In His Time"
The 'In His Time' video submission guidelines set out the conditions under which users may submit videos of the game content 'In His Time' on the Internet. Users may only post videos of themselves playing the game if they comply with these guidelines.
Users are not required to contact the User individually when posting play videos of In His Time in accordance with these Guidelines.

■Play videos that can be posted
Users may submit videos of the Game being played by players, including themselves, in accordance with these Guidelines. Videos that are not played by the user themselves are not covered by these Guidelines.
When posting such videos, you may also use a screenshot of the Game in the thumbnail accompanying the video.

■Editing play videos
You may edit and process the play videos you submit and use them in so-called game playlists, for example by combining them with your face and voice.
However, in this case, the following three conditions must be observed.
➀You may not extract only certain elements from the game, such as background music or images of characters.
➁You must not infringe on the rights of any third party by processing or editing the video of the play.
➂Any other excessive editing or processing that prevents a correct understanding of the contents of this game must not be made.

■Prohibitions when posting play videos
The following acts are prohibited when users post play videos. In addition, regardless of whether or not the following prohibited acts are applicable, please delete your submission as soon as possible upon request from us.
- Posting for commercial purposes. However, monetisation using the system on the posted video distribution site shall not be regarded as a commercial purpose, as far as the interpretation of these Guidelines is concerned.
- Submissions for the purpose of political activities.
- Including content that is offensive to public order and morals, or combining it with illegal information.
- Reproducing videos created by third parties without authorisation.

[Thumbnail material].
https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1xWoXi6Z73wfM_AJr_DF3BjkID60n1Kdy
Please use freely within the scope of common sense!
